variants.name: Salmon with Prawns & Vegetables 85 g
variants.about_this_item: Monge Natural Superpremium BWild Grain Free Salmon with prawns and vegetables (green beans and carrots) is a complete and balanced food for adult sterilised cats. The food is specially formulated for the well-being of sterilised cats, thanks to its increased fibre content and reduced fat content, which helps to maintain a slim figure . The food recipe has been enriched with shrimp, a source of protein with high biological value, and xylo-oligosaccharides (XOS), a new generation of prebiotics that support proper intestinal function. It contains Yucca Schidigera extract, which reduces faecal odours .
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Salmon (26%), pork liver, chicken meat, shrimps (4%), fresh carrots (2%), dried tomato pomace, dried green beans 1% (equal to 9% of fresh green beans), pea fibre (1%), minerals, hydrolysed animal protein, xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.1%), yucca schidigera (0.1%), spirulina.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 11%, Crude fibre: 1.5%, Crude fat: 4.2%, Crude ash: 2.4%, Moisture: 79%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin D3 168 IU/kg, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate) 26 mg/kg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.01 mg/kg) 0.005 mg/kg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 2.25 mg/kg) 0.73 mg/kg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 10.5 mg/kg): 8.4 mg/kg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 0.9 mg/kg) 0.22 mg/kg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 7.5 mg/kg) 2.46 mg/kg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 0.12 mg/kg) 0.08 mg/kg, taurine 400 mg/kg.
